change_summary: Replaced the strict-equality report_date/positions_as_of comparison in quant/live_position_control_ledger.py with a staleness ordering (_positions_snapshot_stale: blocker only when positions_as_of < report_date). Updated tests: fresher-snapshot evening-run shape no longer raises the blocker; new test pins that a stale snapshot (2026-07-26 broker-outage shape) still raises it and fails ok_to_add closed.
hypothesis: The live position-control ledger blocker report_open_positions_asof_mismatch is a semantic-relevance defect: it compares report_date to positions_as_of with strict string equality, but moomoo_open_positions stamps as_of with the UTC calendar date, so every normal post-close Pacific-evening run produces positions_as_of = report_date + 1 and the blocker has fired 100% of days since the ledger's first day (2026-07-07), making ok_to_add_control_pass permanently false and zero-information. The check should be ordering-based: block only when positions_as_of is OLDER than report_date (true staleness, e.g. the 2026-07-26 broker-refresh outage which must remain blocked), not when the snapshot is fresher than the report.
notes: Replay of all 18 ledger days (2026-07-07..2026-07-26): old rule fired 18/18 (17 false positives from UTC as_of stamping vs Pacific evening report date, 1 true staleness); new rule fires exactly on the single true-staleness day 2026-07-26 (moomoo OpenD weekend outage, precedent 2026-07-04 window). OpenD connectivity re-verified recovered via read-only preview on 2026-07-27 (13 positions, as_of matches). ok_to_add_control_pass was structurally impossible before this repair; remaining blockers (manual_bracket_orders_not_broker_confirmed) are genuine manual-pilot state. Observe-only surface: no orders, ranking, sizing changed. Routine-materialization guard override used because the fingerprint keyed on 'ledger' wording; this is a semantic-relevance-defect fault repair per section 2.4 common exemption, not delta materialization.
